policy: Every emitted notice is tracked. Positive-solid execution is not semantic fidelity. A closed gap needs a retained regression and evidence; source-behavior diagnostics may remain visible. Research sources/reports remain external.

gaps.current: Numeric lettering now retains six-significant-digit SCAD formatting, including exponent boundaries and halfway rounding.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Original probes against the official OpenSCAD 2021.01 executable; no formatter implementation copied.

gaps.current: Literal and parameter-driven messages are retained in solid, profile and scalar expression assertions, including default and ignored arguments.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Official 2021.01 executable confirms six-significant-digit expression assertion messages. Guarded failed edits preserve the last valid model and its history.

gaps.current: Disclosed native repeatable randomness remains a substitution. New constant small calls can use bounded deterministic snapshots; constant unseeded snapshots use a source-derived stream. Live seeded/range parameters retain native symbolic behavior. None claims upstream stream parity.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: match integer, fractional, negative and large seeds plus sequential-call context against an executable oracle; do not remove the notice before conformance.

gaps.current: Bundled Droid family substitution; requested fonts, styles, shaping and kerning are not fully reproduced.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: bounded supplied-font assets with licence/provenance, exact face selection, outline/shaping tests. Complexity metadata is not font-fidelity support.

gaps.current: Source colour and alpha are validated but not retained in SCAD CSG.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: retained appearance nodes, material/face propagation, viewport and multicolour export round trips.

gaps.current: Numeric selectors are retained; original string settings require source reimport.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: typed string/enum parameters through core, GUI, source synchronisation, CLI/MCP, save/history.

gaps.current: Echo geometry is preserved but diagnostic output is omitted.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: bounded retained diagnostics with parameter-aware formatting, source spans and optional console UI.

gaps.current: Full-render geometry is retained; preview highlight styling is omitted.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: optional preview annotations separate from printable geometry/history.

gaps.current: Harmless unrecognized names/extra arguments are diagnosed and ignored. Known unsupported geometry arguments such as linear_extrude(v=...) remain refused.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Executable probes confirm circle(h=...) and extra sphere arguments; expand the conformance set as signatures evolve.

gaps.current: Extra module/function arguments are ignored with a notice.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Retain diagnostics rather than claiming the original source was typo-free.

gaps.current: Undefined/empty polygon values contribute empty geometry with a notice.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Verify complete edge cases against reference rendering; a nonempty final solid does not prove no shape was unintentionally lost.

gaps.current: Conversion evaluates selected JSCAD inputs; original JS is needed for later parametric edits.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: retained restricted AST/source-backed features with invalidation and GUI parameter editing.

gaps.current: Coarse twist triangulation can differ from the MIT reference.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: A measured discrepancy is retained. Next: equivalent slice topology and sampling, with volume/bounds/mesh tests.

gaps.current: Core/CLI expose separate outputs; the code editor combines them into one rigid body.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: choose separate editable bodies in GUI insertion; preserve colours, transforms and provenance.

gaps.current: Only flat whole-output colours are retained in metadata.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Share the retained appearance/material work with SCAD; verify viewport and 3MF, not just metadata.

gaps.current: Absent SCAD fragment controls retain native 48 segments. Explicit fractional slices truncate and straight untwisted untapered nonpositive slices are handled equivalently; automatic twisted/tapered slicing remains unsupported.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: radius-aware default $fa/$fs across all curved primitives, text curves and extrusions; preserve old saved native programs.

gaps.current: Explicit hash-checked in-memory SCAD include/use bundles now retain lexical scopes, original files and provenance. Implicit host/network resolution, external meshes, SVG/DXF imports and heightmaps remain unsupported.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Verified paths, hashes, cycles and aggregate size/depth/token budgets; original dependency grants survive insertion/export/history. Next: bounded geometry/heightmap asset records and exact source-to-asset references; never implicit host IO.

gaps.current: 4,096 expanded nodes, 200,000 estimated/evaluated faces, bounded loops, expressions and source remain deliberate limits.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Optimize shared expressions/geometry first; measure complete operations and memory before changing a limit. Distinguish resource limits from malformed inputs.

gaps.current: General recursion, C-style comprehensions, dynamic searches/strings and some matrix/list operations remain incomplete.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Keep first-blocker aggregates and add an original reproducer for each implemented class.

gaps.current: Some corpus files are malformed, declarations-only, empty, or reference missing author modules/assets.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Do not invent replacement geometry, skip dependencies, or count source repairs as engine coverage.

gaps.current: Unbound $t imports the static full-render frame at zero; authored overrides are respected.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Retain an explicit animation-time parameter and time-dependent feature evaluation; integrate mechanism/motion constraints rather than claiming a static frame simulates authored animation.

gaps.current: Retained 2D/3D resize uses evaluated bounds, supports several targets, automatic masks and all-zero identity, preserving empty inputs and parameter edits.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Original official-2021.01 executable probes verify the largest requested scale, 2D third-axis handling and Boolean/numeric option distinctions. Jolt rays verify resized holes and stale-collision rejection.

gaps.current: Native and SCAD resize round trips are retained. JSCAD snapshot export refuses resize because conservative bounds cannot determine exact scaling after cuts or offsets.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Next: supply evaluated bounds/geometry through the export boundary, or a compatible bounded runtime measurement contract, without freezing parameters or guessing CSG bounds.

gaps.current: Retained native loft and bounded JSCAD extrudeFromSlices callbacks accept matching simple planar XY sections ordered on Z, capped at both ends. slice.fromPoints, slice.transform, translation/scaling matrices and safe record spread are supported. No source is resampled.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Real MIT JSCAD volume and bounds, analytic loft volume, parameter/history round trips and Jolt cutout tests. General tilted sections, changing vertex counts, holes in sections, default callbacks, open/closed sweeps and the full authored nutsAndBolts workload remain unsupported or resource-limited.

gaps.current: Numeric ranges, nested scalar comprehensions, each, filters and joined lists retain parameter dependencies and guarded empty results under existing range/work limits.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Original official-2021.01 executable confirms nested/filter/empty/each/negative probes. Vector/lexicographic extrema and C-style comprehensions remain unsupported.

gaps.current: Full-turn noncircular cylinderElliptic radii lower to a compact retained native elliptical taper, including point tips.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Direct MIT JSCAD volume/bounds checks and real Jolt bore rays. Line ends, angle intervals and fractional elliptic tessellation remain unsupported.

gaps.current: Axis scale/mirror aliases, nested transform targets and padded scale vectors work for supported planar profiles and solids.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Direct MIT JSCAD comparisons. Mixed profile/solid targets and transformations outside the supported profile plane remain refused.

gaps.current: Torus, ellipsoid without custom axes, and roundedCylinder lower to compact native constructors; partial rings and coarse/odd resolutions are compared against MIT JSCAD.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Native sphere geometry is unchanged. Custom ellipsoid axes, fractional segment handling, self-touching/spindle tori and arbitrary swept profiles remain unsupported. Large evaluated mesh exports retain existing text budgets.

gaps.current: Module dispatch does not consume an emitted-shape depth level. Independent 32-call module recursion, construction depth, work and compiler limits remain enforced.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: Original 24-wrapper synthetic model reduces to a box; unbounded recursion and deeply transformed recursion remain resource-limit errors.

gaps.current: Per-axis hull conditioning fixes a reproduced rounded-part ray miss on an axis-aligned internal seam; exact seam and nearby rays are retained regressions.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: No Jolt fork change. General oblique seam/contact qualification and dynamic long-run mechanism fixtures remain separate work.

gaps.current: Parenthesized generator bodies remain unsupported; a newly reached case is currently reported as invalid-source rather than unsupported-feature.
gaps.nextOrEvidence: A read-only official OpenSCAD 2021.01 executable probe accepts the original external research input and emits CSG. Add an original minimal conformance probe and bounded retained parentheses support; do not relabel the file malformed.
